name: Single-Event In-Scattering Approximation
definition: An approximation for the total in-scattering $L$ due to direct illumination along a ray path. Instead of summing contributions from all $N$ scattering events, it selects a single representative sample $(X, W)$ per path to approximate the expectation value $ ar{L}$.
summary: The Single-Event In-Scattering Approximation estimates in-scattered radiance by selecting a single representative scattering sample per path, avoiding the computational cost of summing all events while maintaining unbiased expectations.
